reasoning_summary: Selected features cover broad credit-risk semantic groups including credit score, indebtedness, leverage, utilization, repayment behavior, and customer history. Priority was given to stable, interpretable variables with zero missingness and broad coverage. Redundancy was controlled by preferring representative aggregates over near-duplicates unless variants added distinct operational or interpretability value. Features with potential leakage or unstable sparse tail distributions were avoided. The selection balances durable credit signals and operational defensibility for stable out-of-time generalization.
